_comment: Copy this to `ecosine-locations.json` and describe the places your fleet actually sits. Keyed by the way the location is written in your vehicle sheet, lowercased. `aliases` catch the other spellings that turn up in the same column — sheets rarely spell a workshop the same way twice. Add a location here and the fleet agent can name it properly and place it on a map; anything it cannot match it reports rather than guessing. `ecosine-locations.json` is git-ignored: where your vehicles live is your business, not this repository's. The file is optional — without it, locations are reported exactly as the sheet writes them.
